title: Record Management System
description: A complete web-based Record Management System built for Revolutionary Union (RU) to efficiently manage members, records and organizational operations.
problem: The organization relied on paper records and spreadsheets, making it difficult to track members, retrieve records quickly and maintain accurate information.
solution: Designed and developed a secure web application with role-based authentication, centralized record storage, powerful search functionality and a user-friendly dashboard.
outcome: The system improved record accessibility, reduced paperwork and simplified daily administrative tasks.
